---
title: Spaghetti with Tuna
id: MAR-0112
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g spaghetti
- 100 g tuna in oil
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 1 garlic clove
- 2 anchovy fillets
- 100 g tomato sauce
- 1 tablespoon parsley
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Drain the tuna and break it into coarse pieces.
2. Chop the anchovies.
3. Crush the garlic, peel it, and let it wilt in a pan with the oil.
4. After 4 minutes, remove it, add the tuna and anchovies, and stir; after 4 minutes, add the tomato sauce and parsley, and cook for another 3-4 minutes.
5. Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water, drain them, and pour them into the pan with 3 tablespoons of their cooking water; stir and serve.
